introduction: Montana Legal Services Association offers civil legal aid and public self-help resources. Online intake places applicants on a callback list.
description: Montana Legal Services Association offers civil legal aid and public self-help resources. Online intake places applicants on a callback list.

sections.who: The provider screens eligibility and case capacity. Public information and forms are available through MontanaLawHelp.
sections.get: Accepted cases may receive advice or representation. Separate applications exist for certain housing and family-mediation services.

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use MLSA’s application page.

  2. Call if needed

    HelpLine800-666-6899 is listed Tuesday–Thursday,9a.m.–1p.m.

  3. Prepare for callback

    Explain deadlines and provide records through the confirmed intake route.
sections.after: Keep deadlines. Callback placement is not acceptance of representation.
